New project

Source: R/class_Project.R
new_project.Rd

Create a new project object.

Usage

new_project(
  zones,
  bbox,
  dataset,
  tiles,
  costs,
  features,
  locks,
  solutions = list(),
  name = "Project",
  author_name = "Unknown",
  author_email = "Unknown",
  version = NULL,
  bearing = 0,
  zoom = 0
)

Arguments

zones

character vector of zone names.

bbox

sf::st_bbox() object.

dataset

new_dataset() object.

tiles

list of new_tile() objects.

costs

list of new_cost() objects.

features

list of new_feature() objects.

locks

list of new_lock() objects.

solutions

list of new_solution() objects. Defaults to an empty list().

name

character name of the project. Defaults to "Project".

author_name

character name of the project author. Defaults to "Unknown".

author_email

character email of the project author. Defaults to "Unknown".

version

character version of package used to create the project. Defaults to NULL, such that the current package version is used.

bearing

numeric value denoting the initial map rotation. Defaults to 0.

zoom

numeric value denoting the initial map zoom. Defaults to 0.

Value

A new Project object.

See also

Other functions for defining classes: Dataset, Project, new_categorical_legend(), new_continuous_legend(), new_cost(), new_feature(), new_layer(), new_lock(), new_provenance(), new_solution(), new_theme(), new_tile()

Examples

# simulate spatial data
sim_data <- simulate_spatial_data()

# prepare data
dataset <- create_dataset_from_sf(sim_data)
tile <- create_tile_from_sf(sim_data)

# create cost
cost <- new_cost(
  name = "cost",
  zone = "Science",
  weight = 0.1,
  layer = new_layer(
    column = "feat_1",
    total = 500,
    dataset = dataset,
    tile = tile,
    legend = simulate_continuous_legend(),
    provenance = simulate_provenance()
  )
)

# create lock
lock <- new_lock(
  name = "lock",
  zone = "Biodiversity",
  layer = new_layer(
    column = "locked_in",
    total = 30,
    dataset = dataset,
    tile = tile,
    legend = simulate_continuous_legend(),
    provenance = simulate_provenance()
  )
)

# create features
features <- list(
  new_feature(
    name = "f1",
    zone_targets = c(0.1, 0.2, 0.5),
    zone_weights = c(0.2, 0.1, 0.3),
    zone_helds = c(0, 0.1, 0),
    themes = list(new_theme(zone = "Biodiversity", name = "Penguins")),
    layer = new_layer(
      column = "feat_1",
      total = 500,
      dataset = dataset,
      tile = tile,
      legend = simulate_continuous_legend(),
      provenance = simulate_provenance()
    )
  ),
  new_feature(
    name = "f2",
    zone_targets = c(0.01, 0.04, 0.9),
    zone_weights = c(0.8, 0.1, 0.05),
    zone_helds = c(0.2, 0, 0),
    themes = list(
      new_theme(zone = "Biodiversity", name = "Penguins"),
      new_theme(zone = "Tourism", name = "Charismatic species")
    ),
    layer = new_layer(
      column = "feat_2",
      total = 200,
      dataset = dataset,
      tile = tile,
      legend = simulate_continuous_legend(),
      provenance = simulate_provenance()
    )
  )
)

# create project
x <- new_project(
  zones = c("Biodiversity", "Tourism", "Science"),
  bbox = sf::st_bbox(sim_data),
  dataset = dataset,
  tiles = list(tile),
  costs = list(cost),
  locks = list(lock),
  features = features
)

# preview object
print(x)
#> A <Project> object.
